sentence: This project builds a treatment using electrical stimulation, conductive scaffolds and small molecules to help bone regrow in diabetic and aged patients.
This project tests whether a protein called nicotinamide N-methyltransferase lowers chemical marks on mRNA in triple-negative breast cancer cells.
This project studies how autophagy and vesicle trafficking interact in breast cancer cells.
This project studies and tries to change how microglia engulf material in Alzheimer's disease.
This project tries to find out the genetic basis of infertility in men.
This project builds ways to measure peptide release in frontal cortex and to check the activity of cells that peptides act on.
This project builds and tests nanodroplets activated by ultrasound to switch on the body's immune system against tumors.
This project studies how commensal respiratory viruses interact with the human host, using sequencing, proteomics and reverse genetics.
This project tests drugs on human stem cell brain organoids to find ones that block the spread of tau protein.
This project supports basic research on microbial infections and immunity.
This project tries to find out what long non-coding RNAs do in pluripotency and lineage commitment and which pathways they regulate.
This project studies an epigenetic mechanism that controls cell fates in stem cells.
This project tries to link single nucleotide variants in Tibetan highlanders to carbon monoxide production and to pulmonary arterial hypertension treatment.
This project develops strategies to find people who should get genetic testing and treatment early in life.
This project studies how invasive trophoblast cells develop and form the uterine-placental interface.
This project builds a network to improve the diagnosis of rare diseases in Congolese patients.
This project builds a medical imaging core that provides tools and testbeds for cancer research.
This project tests whether combining two cancer drugs can reduce latent HIV reservoirs and protect brain cells from inflammation.
This project studies how genes and regulators control the stability of regulatory T cells.
This project tests whether a social media intervention helps emerging adults with high intensity drinking.
